messages:
maria: Heads up — we just saw a spike of 'structured-output validation' errors in prod. Dashboard shows a 12% jump in tool-call rejects for the last 30m. Anyone digging? :eyes:
kevin: I can pull logs. Is this fncall or toolhook traffic?
maria: Toolhook. The validator is rejecting payloads with extra top-level fields — started after yesterday's model binary rollout.
ellen: Can we get a sample? If model variant changed shape, we should route to permissive fallback, not hard reject.
kevin: Sample attached: `{"result":{"summary":"...","unexpected_meta":123}}` — validator expects `result` object with keys [text,score] only.
raj: Sounds like a schema drift case. Question: do we treat these as user errors (chargeable) or system/variant-induced rejects (not chargeable)?
maria: Currently they count as validation rejects and show up against customer token usage in the billing view — which is noisy here. We need better classification.
ellen: Agreed. For rollout UX we should surface a new flag: `validation.reason=incompatible-model-variant` so the console can auto-apply a non-billable tag and route telemetry to rollout alerts instead of billing.
kevin: Implementation idea: add a validator tag enum — {user_invalid, model_shape_drift, transient_parse_error}. Emit that in the event envelope and in the per-route trace.
raj: Also need to update quota behavior: for model_shape_drift we should bypass hard quota decrement and instead decrement a telemetry-only counter. Otherwise customers get throttled for something caused by our model variant change.
maria: Ops: can we do a quick canary change to mark these rejects as non-billable for the affected model ID? I want to avoid mass customer complaints.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary patch `validator:soft-label` to eu-west cluster (2/5 instances).
ellen: UX question: how does console present this? Right now the 'validation rejects' graph is a single line. We need stacked breakdown by reason and a visible annotation for rollouts.
kevin: Will add telemetry fields: `validation_reason`, `model_variant`, `route_id`, `is_billable` to the existing sampling embed. Sampling rate for rejects should be increased from 1% -> 10% during rollouts.
raj: Make sure to include trace_id in the sample so SRE can follow request -> model -> validator path.
maria: Also add a short-term alert: if model_shape_drift rejects > 5% for 5m, trigger paging to eng-runtime oncall.
ellen: One more thing — product asked for a 'soft-preview' toggle so customers can opt-in to permissive parsing during canaries. That change will require an API param and console toggle.
kevin: Feels reasonable. Timeline? I can PR the telemetry + tag now, but billing team needs to sign off on non-billable semantics.
raj: I'll loop in @finance-billing. Also we need a migration plan for historical rejects so dashboards don't show a permanent spike. Suggest we backfill a derived metric `validation_rejects_adjusted` that filters out model_shape_drift once tag exists.
maria: Action items: kevin -> PR telemetry + tag; ellen -> console chart breakdown mock; raj -> billing + oncall notification rule; maria -> coordinate canary patch and customer comms.
kevin: On it. PR link when ready.
ellen: Mock done, will post screenshots in #eng-platform-design.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary patch `validator:soft-label` complete on 2/5, rolling to 3/5 in 10m.
kevin: Quick note: ensure the validator package doesn't silently coerce fields — we only want a label, not permissive parsing unless customer toggles opt-in.
maria: Correct. Keep strict validation default. Opt-in only behind toggle.
raj: Filed ticket BILL-324 for billing decision. Paging playbook updated in infra-runbook.
maria: Thanks team. Will follow up in 30m with status update. :thumbsup:
